_about: Authored prose ONLY for the round-2 matrices page (gen-matrices.js --round 2). Every number is a {token} the generator fills from m1-input.json · m1-endpoint.json · inventory-endpoint.md · prisms-endpoint.json and m1-cluster.js's arithmetic; a digit typed in here is a bug (a decision's id, D-0NN, is a name, not a fact). Block names, plain lines and standpoints are NOT repeated here — they live in prisms-endpoint.json. A block the arithmetic merged is named by the ruled blocks it holds, from the data. The round-1 takes for the matrix, the spine, the plan and the leftovers are reused from prisms-endpoint.json; only the points-of-view takes change with the cut.

head.eyebrow: design context · loop 1 · step 2 of 6 · round 2
head.title: Which attributes answer which questions — round 2
head.lede: {nq} questions you ask about an endpoint, against the {na} attributes M1 round 2 rated. A filled square means you need that attribute on screen to answer that question. The squares are the round-2 data; how the columns are cut into blocks is the one thing on this page that is a ruling, not arithmetic.

statement.title: A cut the arithmetic did not choose

statement.how: The arithmetic cuts where the drop between two joins is widest — {arithDrop}, after {arithJoins} joins. The runner-up drop, {runnerDrop}, would leave {runnerN} blocks.
statement.ruledOn: Your {ruledN} are this same ladder stopped after {ruledJoins} joins, at a drop of {ruledDrop} — {ruledRank} of the drops the rule weighs.
statement.ruledOff: Your {ruledN} are not a cut of this ladder: no number of joins draws them.
statement.why: D-021 keeps your {ruledN}. The round-2 cells stand as data: every attribute's home and the top band are read from them over your blocks. Only the cut is yours.
statement.mergesHead: What the arithmetic merged that you keep apart

statement.pick: Shown as a switch, not side by side: two copies of a {na}-row, {nq}-column matrix do not fit beside each other in one column, and a switch keeps one matrix at full size with every section below following the same cut.
